body:
October 29 — release-gate corrections; publication still pending.

Application integration/recovery fixes are committed and pushed in 12f1769, with lazy artifact proof and the native verifier in c6c42de. Beta.22 failed clean-checkout startup tests; beta.23 passes its full exact-tag CI and locally workspace-built packaged smoke, but inspection of the downloaded draft ZIP confirms a stale compiled research revision (12f1769) beside Main metadata c6c42de reporting clean. Neither candidate is published; immutable tags and raw failures remain retained.

Beta.24 now prepares a mandatory workspace generation/build before desktop packaging, rejects unchanged stale generated content and adds embedded source/version agreement to packaged smoke. The new real-Git regression failed before the fix and passes afterward. Cold typecheck/lint pass and the production audit reports zero vulnerabilities; the full unbuilt-checkout suite is running. Final matching-tag package/native/download/publication evidence remains pending. [Delivery](https://github.com/kokin-blip/Coqui-Crypto/blob/codex/operations-crew-journal/docs/implementation/beta24-macos-release-2026-10-29.md) will record actual outcomes.

All P0–P7 requirements, negative/frozen/consumed evidence, unrelated work and outstanding owner/reviewer/connected-account/host/financial/dispatch/prospective/elapsed/qualification gates remain preserved. No actual profile or financial/research authority changes. Keep issue status In Review, dependencies and assignee unchanged.

**Prompt used**

Ok release a new release with all these new updates. mac build only.

Annotation follow-up:

> commit those

Scope clarification:

> No comit those and add all the new changes in the new release.

Completed by: kokin
